seo.title: Sign in — Alder Health
seo.description: Sign in to the Alder Health patient account. This is a design demonstration, so no real account or sign-in service exists behind the form.

intro.title: Welcome back.
intro.lead: Sign in to see your example appointments, reschedule a visit, or update how we reach you.

form.rememberLabel: Keep me signed in on this device
form.unavailableMessage: Nothing was sent. There is no account service behind this form, so no sign-in took place.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter an email address in the format you@example.com.

notice.title: Sign-in is not connected
notice.copy: Alder Health is a design demonstration. There is no account service behind this form, so no password is checked and nothing you type is sent anywhere or stored. The form is here to show the signed-out experience.

alternative.heading: No account yet?
alternative.copy: Registration is not part of this demonstration. You can still browse the example clinicians and walk through a booking without an account.
